Source: https://github.com/iOrange/bcdec `bcdec.h` at commit 80859ed (version 0.985), with two local changes: the byte order mark at its start is gone, and the signed BC4 / BC5 endpoints are read as `signed char` instead of `char`, which is unsigned on ARM (Android): every signed BC4 / BC5 texel came out positive. License in LICENSE (MIT or the Unlicense, your choice; the same text ends the header).
Use: the Android Vulkan backend decodes BC1-BC7 textures on the CPU with it where the device has no BC textures (`dm/android/gfx_vk_tex.c` `bc_decode`, with `BCDEC_STATIC` and `BCDEC_BC4BC5_PRECISE`): the Vulkan 1.1 drivers of the Adreno 618 / 619 (512.530, 2021) have no `textureCompressionBC`. First needed by Super Mario Bros. Wonder on a Moto g 5G 2024 (issue #15).
